title: Uniform Residential Loan Application (Fannie Mae Form 1003 / Freddie Mac Form 65)

lender_loan_information.description: The 'To be completed by the Lender' box at the top of page 1.

lender_loan_number.description: Lender Loan No., as printed before the slash.

universal_loan_identifier.description: Universal Loan Identifier (ULI), as printed after the slash, joined into one string without line breaks.

agency_case_number.description: Agency Case No., or null if blank.

ssn.description: Social Security Number or ITIN, as printed.

type_of_credit.description: Whether the borrower is applying for individual or joint credit.

number_of_dependents.description: Number of dependents not listed by another borrower.

current_address.description: Current address: street, unit, city, state, ZIP, joined into one line.

years_at_current_address.description: How long at current address: years.

months_at_current_address.description: How long at current address: months.

housing.description: The selected Housing option for the current address.

employer_address.description: Employer street, city, state and ZIP, joined into one line.

years_in_line_of_work.description: How long in this line of work: years.

is_self_employed.description: True if 'Check if you are the Business Owner or Self-Employed' is checked.

gross_monthly_income.description: The Gross Monthly Income column of section 1b, in dollars per month. Null for blank lines.

liabilities.description: Section 2c. Liabilities - Credit Cards, Other Debts, and Leases, one entry per row.

account_type.description: Account type, e.g. Revolving or Installment.

account_number.description: Account number as printed, including masking characters, joined without line breaks.

to_be_paid_off.description: True if 'To be paid off at or before closing' is checked.

monthly_payment.description: Monthly payment, in dollars, as a positive number even if printed in parentheses.

real_estate_owned.description: Section 3a. Property You Own, one entry per property.

address.description: Property address, joined into one line.

status.description: Status: Sold, Pending Sale, or Retained.

intended_occupancy.description: Intended occupancy: Investment, Primary Residence, Second Home or Other.

monthly_mortgage_payment.description: Monthly mortgage payment, in dollars, as a positive number.

to_be_paid_off.description: True if 'To be paid off at or before closing' is checked.

loan_type.description: Type: FHA, VA, Conventional, USDA-RD or Other.

property_address.description: Property address: street, unit, city, state, ZIP, joined into one line.

mixed_use_property.description: Answer to question 1, Mixed-Use Property: true for YES.

manufactured_home.description: Answer to question 2, Manufactured Home: true for YES.

declarations.description: Section 5. Declarations: the selected answer to each question, true for YES and false for NO.

a_occupy_as_primary_residence.description: A. Will you occupy the property as your primary residence?

a_ownership_interest_last_three_years.description: A. If YES, have you had an ownership interest in another property in the last three years?

c_undisclosed_borrowed_money.description: C. Are you borrowing any money for this transaction that you have not disclosed?

g_outstanding_judgments.description: G. Are there any outstanding judgments against you?

h_delinquent_on_federal_debt.description: H. Are you currently delinquent or in default on a Federal debt?

l_foreclosure_last_7_years.description: L. Have you had property foreclosed upon in the last 7 years?

m_bankruptcy_last_7_years.description: M. Have you declared bankruptcy within the past 7 years?

military_service.description: Section 7: true if the borrower answered YES to having served in the U.S. Armed Forces.

ethnicity.description: Every checked Ethnicity option, by its printed label.

sex.description: Every checked Sex option, by its printed label.

race.description: Every checked Race option, by its printed label.

provided_through.description: The selected option for 'The Demographic Information was provided through'.

signature_date.description: Loan originator signature date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

borrower_signature_date.description: Date the borrower signed Section 6, as YYYY-MM-DD.

mortgage_loan_information.description: Lender Loan Information sections L1 and L3.

refinance_type.description: L1 Refinance Type: No Cash Out, Limited Cash Out or Cash Out.

mortgage_type.description: L3 Mortgage Type Applied For: Conventional, USDA-RD, FHA, VA or Other.

lien_type.description: Mortgage Lien Type: First Lien or Subordinate Lien.

amortization_type.description: Amortization Type: Fixed Rate, Adjustable Rate or Other.

initial_adjustment_period_months.description: If Adjustable Rate: Initial Period Prior to First Adjustment, in months.

subsequent_adjustment_period_months.description: If Adjustable Rate: Subsequent Adjustment Period, in months.

proposed_monthly_payment.description: Proposed Monthly Payment for Property, in dollars. Null for blank lines.

qualifying_the_borrower.description: L4. Qualifying the Borrower - Minimum Required Funds or Cash Back, in dollars. Null for blank lines.

mortgage_loans_paid_off.description: D. Balance of mortgage loans on the property to be paid off.

credit_cards_and_other_debts_paid_off.description: E. Credit Cards and Other Debts Paid Off.

cash_from_to_borrower.description: Cash From/To the Borrower; negative means cash to the borrower.
